(ii) If value of k is [a, b] in the interval k ∈ (−π, π) the equation sin x + cos(k + n) + cos(k − n) = 2 has real solution then sum of a + b is ______. (iii) Find the number of integral values of k for which the equation 7cos x + 5sin x = 2k + 1 has at least one solution ______. (iv) General solution of sin^(2)θ > cos^(2)θ is nπ + π/4 < θ < nπ + pπ/4 where n ∈ Z then p is ______.
